## Historical audit: S0107

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/generic_rsi/C1/development/commons_118588033/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file. Only chunk 2 is visible; the referenced images themselves are not available for this audit.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Line 19, student `model_request`, characters [0,155301) | **Goal:** reconstruct a photograph as editable SceneAct meshes with matching camera, framing, colors and materials. The student hypothesized a narrow shipboard compartment; that semantic interpretation is not independently verified. |
| Line 19, embedded student programs | **Actual construction:** multiple named assets include architecture, three bunks, cabinets, lockers, chair, machinery, pipes, fittings and lamps. Parts include rails, legs and supports; the third build adds cabinet mounting feet intended to connect them to a bench. Hierarchical grouping and intended supports are observable in code, not proof of physical contact or correct geometry. No articulated human or animal pose is evidenced; object placement is specified by coordinates. |
| Line 19, embedded step 1–3 programs and runner results | **Autonomous revision:** after step 1 the student attributed mismatch to pale lighting and changed palette, lights, berth and lockers, and added a wall return while holding the camera fixed. After step 2 it attributed mismatch to depth and overlap, moving or resizing groups and repositioning fittings. These are student diagnoses, not independently verified visual findings. Procedural noise/bump, roughness and emission were configured; texture fidelity remains unverified. |
| Line 19, embedded execution results | **Visible validation:** all three runs report `ok: true`, completed renders and saved scene files; primitive counts were 238, 241 and 245. This establishes technical execution, not visual or geometric correctness. The student claimed anchor comparisons, but the image pixels are not present here to verify framing, lighting, occlusion or improvement. |
| Line 19; lines 20–22, characters [0,5753), [0,350), [0,59) respectively | With no executions left, the controller requested selection among successful builds. The student replied `SELECT 3`; the selection event records step 3. The final selection session completed with zero tool calls. The record does not independently establish that step 3 was visually strongest. |

**Teacher input and adoption:** No teacher message, detection, diagnosis or proposed update is visible in this chunk. Therefore neither teacher receipt nor adoption can be established; the controller’s review instructions should not be treated as teacher feedback.

**Outcome and lessons:** Formal execution and selection succeeded; reconstruction correctness is **unknown**, not proven by success flags or the student’s claims. There is no visible empty patch, algorithm failure or technical interruption. A transferable process lesson is to distinguish executable renders and named, editable assemblies from validated image matches. The particular wall return, depth changes and lighting diagnosis are task-specific hypotheses. Whether supports actually meet, whether the selected view matches the photograph, and whether the revisions improved it remain unresolved without the images or independent geometric checks.
